cohort: The study enrolled 1,113 Korean children, aged 7 years, from the COhort for Childhood Origin of Asthma and allergic diseases (COCOA) study.
finding: 4.4% of Korean children had a moderate-to-severe persistent AR phenotype, with early sensitization to Der p, Der f, birch, and Japanese hop at age 3 and prenatal antibiotic use identified as risk factors.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with the mild-intermittent AR phenotype.
